subject: Pilot bridge: temporary credit allocation while procurement completes
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.in>
To: Samira Khan <samira@brightlinelabs.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.in>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot bridge: temporary credit allocation while procurement completes

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — really excited about the Brightline use case (semantic search + embeddings at scale). I understand procurement needs a PO and an SCC review before we can flip to a paid Dedicated seat, and that timeline might be 2–3 weeks.

To keep engineering momentum and let your team finish the integration tests, we can extend a one-off temporary allocation: 10,000 free sandbox tokens (valid for 21 days) and a short-term temporary API key scoped to a non-production project. This is intended to be a bridge — not a precedent for production access — and would come with standard sandbox rate limits and basic logs only.

If that works, I can route an internal approval request and send you a DocuSign for the brief temporary authorization (covers usage guardrails & data handling during the trial extension). Can you confirm:
- Name on the PO you expect to issue
- Expected procurement completion date (best estimate)

If you want a different amount or duration, say so and we’ll evaluate.

Cheers,
Sean
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: product-quickstart-checklist.pdf (PDF))

From: Samira Khan <samira@brightlinelabs.com>

Cc: procurement@brightlinelabs.com
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot bridge: temporary credit allocation while procurement completes

Hi Sean —

Really appreciate the offer — that would unblock our integration sprint. Procurement confirmed they will issue a PO, but legal wants a signed short agreement if we use any third-party service beyond the sandbox terms. Our current estimate is PO by 2027-06-18, maybe earlier if we expedite.

PO will be issued to: Brightline Labs, Inc.
Procurement contact: Javier Morales <javier@brightlinelabs.com>

Would 10k tokens / 21 days be appropriate for our tests? If you can include a short statement in the DocuSign that the allocation is a temporary bridge tied to the PO, that would help our legal team. Also, can you provide an invoice or internal approval note we can attach to the PO paperwork?

Thanks — Samira
Head of Integrations
Brightline Labs
